# Rut.ts

> A modern TypeScript library for handling Chilean RUT (Rol Único Tributario) validation, formatting, cleaning, and generation with full type safety.

Rut.ts provides a comprehensive set of utilities for working with Chilean RUTs - the unique tax identification numbers used throughout Chile. The library supports validation (including strict mode for suspicious patterns), formatting (both standard and incremental for real-time input), cleaning, decomposition, random generation, and verifier digit calculation. It's fully typed, tree-shakeable, supports both ESM and CommonJS, and works in Node.js and browsers. The RUT format follows the pattern `XX.XXX.XXX-Y` where the verifier digit is calculated using the Modulo 11 algorithm.

As of **v4.0.0** (a breaking release focused on production identity hardening), `validate()` and `isRutLike()` accept only three canonical shapes — compact (`123456785`), compact + hyphen (`12345678-5`), and canonical dotted (`12.345.678-5`, optionally with leading zeros and surrounding whitespace). Non-canonical dot grouping that 3.x tolerated is now rejected, input is capped at 64 characters as a security bound (not a format rule), and errors are a generic `Invalid RUT input` so Chilean ID values are never echoed into logs or traces. `clean()` and `decompose()` remain intentionally permissive for normalization and must not be treated as validation. Review the CHANGELOG before upgrading from 3.x.

Key technical details:
- **Size**: ~3KB minified, ~1.1KB gzipped
- **Zero dependencies**: Pure TypeScript implementation
- **Safe mode**: All functions support `{ throwOnError: false }` to return `null` instead of throwing
- **Dual package**: Native ESM with CommonJS fallback
- **Type definitions**: Full TypeScript support with exported types

## Core API Functions

- [validate()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/validate): Validate RUT format and verifier digit with optional strict mode to detect suspicious patterns
- [format()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/format): Format RUTs with dots and hyphens, supports incremental mode for real-time input
- [clean()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/clean): Remove formatting, special characters, and leading zeros from RUT strings
- [decompose()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/decompose): Split a RUT into its body (numeric part) and verifier digit components
- [calculateVerifier()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/calculate-verifier): Calculate the correct verifier digit for a given RUT body using Modulo 11
- [generate()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/generate): Generate valid random RUT numbers for testing and development
- [getBody()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/get-body): Extract only the body (numeric part) from a formatted or unformatted RUT
- [getVerifier()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/get-verifier): Extract only the verifier digit from a formatted or unformatted RUT
- [isRutLike()](https://rut.arrowsw.com/docs/features/is-rut-like): Check if a string matches RUT format without full validation
